consumer: select_crafting_recipe (called from Character::craft) presents a full-screen interactive recipe menu and asks 'which recipe did the player browse/filter to and pick?', returning the chosen recipe pointer through the engine's own input loop
scope: the live interactive crafting menu answered through the real active input loop; not the character's item snapshot
decisive_source: src/crafting_gui.cpp::select_crafting_recipe — runs a full-screen interactive menu (browse/filter recipes, pick one, set batch size) through the engine's own input loop and returns the recipe (nullptr on cancel)
divergence: two recipes the player can craft are both available; a shortcut that auto-picks the first/derived recipe from the item snapshot returns the wrong recipe (or a recipe the player did not select), whereas the engine's menu would return exactly the one the player navigated to and confirmed
